body:
## Product

The svc-workflow definition-lane slice of **mayf3/dsh-agent-core#449** ("Workflow v5: distribution nodes loop on missing targetPlatforms and lack scoped recovery"), continuing the merged broker assistance surface (dsh-agent-core PR #450, residual #1). **DRAFT — do not merge without the normal review/acceptance path. PRODUCTION_MUTATION = NONE** (no deploy, no restart, no production definition publish, no instance write, no credential, no raw-store edit).

## Root cause

The engine's only creation-time gate for context validity is the definition version's `context_schema` (jsonschema, enforced at create/revise/repair/revise-and-transition). The published Workflow v5 contract (`bip_article_pipeline_v5_blog_author_202609`) does not require `targetPlatforms`, so instances with missing/`[]`/unknown-platform context were legally created and later stranded at `distribution` as forever-ACTIONABLE_NOW work (production census: 61 identical DISPATCH_INTENT activations, zero authoritative progress). Nothing in the definition lane bound a node's consumed inputs to its schema — the assignee-key coverage rule (`CONTEXT_SCHEMA_REQUIRED_MISSING_ASSIGNEE_KEY`) covers only INSTANCE_INPUT_PRINCIPAL keys, which SMV3 (the v5 model class) forbids entirely.

## Change (smallest, existing mechanisms only)

A node may declare the context inputs it consumes via authoring metadata `requiredContextInputs: [<key>, ...]`. The new rule `validate_declared_context_inputs` runs inside the EXISTING model-agnostic authoring/publish schema pass (`validate_json_schemas` — the same pass that compiles context/submission schemas and already carries the identity-literal grammar), so it covers every semantic model without touching the frozen per-model validators:

- every declared key must be in `context_schema.required` → `DECLARED_CONTEXT_INPUT_NOT_REQUIRED`
- every declared key must be typed by a `properties` entry → `DECLARED_CONTEXT_INPUT_UNTYPED`
- array-typed declared keys must declare `minItems >= 1` → `DECLARED_CONTEXT_INPUT_ALLOWS_EMPTY`
- and a closed non-empty `items.enum` (the registry) → `DECLARED_CONTEXT_INPUT_UNBOUNDED_VALUES`
- malformed declarations fail closed → `DECLARED_CONTEXT_INPUTS_MALFORMED`

Half-declared contracts are rejected at draft-authoring time (the authoring-surface correction the diagnostics catalog exists for) and can never publish. Creation-time refusal stays with the existing schema gate: once the corrected contract is published, missing/`[]`/unknown platform context fails 422 `context_validation_failed` BEFORE any visit exists, so no ACTIONABLE_NOW projection and no dispatchable distribution visit can be minted. Zero deletions; zero touches outside definition authoring — authorization, idempotency, no-replay, CAS, assistance-case, and child-workflow semantics are untouched (independently verified, see Review). No new validator framework/state machine/watcher/queue/DB/role; five static corrections added to the closed diagnostics catalog (load-bearing: uncataloged codes are masked to `GRAPH_VALIDATION_REJECTED`). Node metadata is digest-covered, so declared inputs cannot drift post-publish.

## RED-first

- Base `5d479d8`: declared-but-uncovered inputs authored AND published freely — 5 publish-rule tests RED (`declared_input_not_required_by_schema_fails_publish`, `..._allowing_empty_`, `..._unbounded_values_`, `malformed_declared_inputs_`, SMV3 coverage) plus the required-but-untyped shape RED at pre-amend head `715ceec` (flagged by the independent review as N1 — it re-creates the exact 44dee9da defect through an apparently-covered contract).
- Creation-refusal, idempotent-replay and no-projection assertions pin the frozen context gate over the real engine (real router, real PostgreSQL; only JWKS mocked).

## Tests

- New suite `tests/38_declared_context_inputs_v5_distribution.rs` (7 tests): 5 exact-code authoring-time refusals + SMV3 coverage + corrected-v5-contract e2e (valid registered list → 201; missing/`[]`/unknown → 422; refusal replay is the identical deterministic failure; domain instances == exactly the valid one; worklist and dispatch-intent feed contain nothing for refused contexts — assertions scoped to the test's own domain/instance IDs for shared-DB robustness). Lib-level pins: minItems 0/fractional, empty enum, non-string declaration entries.
- Suite 38: 7/7 GREEN. Definition-lane suites re-verified green: 13 (9), 14 (6), 30 (1), 32 (4), 37 (4). Full `cargo test --no-fail-fast` battery on disposable PostgreSQL: failure set on this head ({01_migration_tests flake, 27 env, 35 feed-windows, outbox×2 env}) is A/B-IDENTICAL to pristine base `5d479d8` on the same infrastructure — 0019 and the outbox failures were reproduced on the base worktree against the same DB state; 27 requires runner-provided `TEST_*_DATABASE_URL`; 01/29/35 are shared-DB order/window-sensitive (pre-existing).
- Environment: disposable `postgres:16-alpine` container; both `TEST_DATABASE_URL` and `DATABASE_URL` set.

## Review

One independent exact-head changed-surface review at `715ceec` (R1 constraint conformance/no-new-mechanism, R2 rule edge cases, R3 business-data leakage, R4 wire accuracy incl. catalog masking path, R5 test non-vacuousness + RED credibility via `git show 5d479d8`, R6 digest/immutability authority, R7 hygiene, R8 residual classification): **REVIEW_VERDICT = PASS, BLOCKERS = NONE**. Reviewer non-blocking N1 (required-but-untyped hole) and N4 (edge-case pins) are folded into this head; N2 (non-object metadata skips silently) and N3 (incident prose in a doc comment) are accepted as-is and recorded here.

## Explicit residuals (out of this repo's bounded slice)

1. Publishing the corrected Workflow v5 definition version (v6: `targetPlatforms` required + typed + `minItems 1` + enum registry + `requiredContextInputs` declaration on the distribution node) is a production definition-lane action, separately authorized; the test file documents the exact contract.
2. The two stranded production instances (86c0cff2, 44dee9da) are already routed through the merged broker assistance surface (dsh-agent-core PR #450); their closure is an owner action, not an engine change.
3. Pre-existing suite-environment issues (01 LIMIT-1 fixture lottery, 27 missing runner env, 29/35 due-feed window exclusivity, outbox regression tests' DB dependence) are untouched — A/B evidence above.

EXACT_HEAD = `6b316a7` (single squashed commit on base `5d479d8`); reviewed semantic head = `715ceec` + N1/N4 amendment.
